0022600220.text: The Chicago Bulls, 1-8 and 14th in the East while on a seven-game losing streak, host the San Antonio Spurs, who are 8-2, lead the Southwest, and are riding an eight-game winning streak. Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (illness) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions for Chicago, while Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain) are out for San Antonio. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Spurs won both of their 2025-26 meetings, most recently 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30, 2026.
